messages:
anya: quick ping  proposing a `safety_probe` flag on runtime config to do traffic-shadowing for small routing changes. snippet below.

anya: ```json
{"route_id":"search-priority","safety_probe":{"enabled":true,"sample":0.01,"gate":"routing.safety_v1"}}
```

brian: 👍 emit metrics: `safety_probe.samples`, `safety_probe.errors`, `safety_probe.latency_delta_ms`. include header `X-Probe-ID` so we can tie to traces.

devex: will build a tiny console card showing last 1h success rate + small sparkline and a "view samples" link. keep it compact.

carol: rollout plan? abort thresholds?

anya: draft: shadow at 1% for 2h, canary 5% for 30m, escalate if no regressions. abort if errors +0.5% or p99 +50ms. gate passes after 99.8% success over 1h.

ops-bot: dryrun queued by anya (job dryrun-1798880001)

ops-bot: DRY-RUN: sampled 250 requests in 10m, errors 0, p99 +9ms. gate: not-passed (0.0 -> needs >=99.8%)

brian: can we capture a sanitized sample blob to internal storage for quick replay? helps RCA.

anya: yes, snapshotting small payloads to internal blobstore with pre-signed URLs. I'll include in PR and docs.

devex: once PR lands I'll prototype the card in staging and post a link.

anya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4999  includes schema, header, and metrics. landing later today unless objections.

carol: sounds good. short and practical. :rocket:
